scope: Read-only source/data/weight checks plus CPU sequence validation; no new GPU experiment or weight training launched
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti, 22528 MiB, 0 MiB, 0 %

protocol.cd_distance: unsquared Euclidean; sum of both directional means
protocol.cd_4d_alignment: one ICP from frame zero, applied to all frames
protocol.cd_motion_correspondence: predicted points share frame-zero face IDs and barycentric coordinates; nearest-neighbor matches to GT established only in frame zero
protocol.units: raw GT coordinate units; no extra normalization or scale multiplier
protocol.gt_correspondence_assumption: surfaces.npy point index is a material correspondence across time, as assumed by the official evaluator
protocol.no_extra_preprocessing: no crop, camera fit, axis flip, interpolation, or frame truncation

summary.mean_scope: successful cases only; never treat failures as zero
summary.means_weighting: case/run weighted; asset-balanced means also provided
